rationale: The stock gapped up ~5.3% on strong earnings (106% EPS beat, 51% revenue growth) but the news is nearly 20 hours old and the price has already pulled back from the session high of $62.74 to $61.79, sitting below the 9-EMA ($62.19) with declining momentum visible in the last few 1-minute candles. With 115 minutes to close and no fresh catalyst, the risk/reward is insufficient in either direction.
